parameters.command: =~/bin/icav2 projectdata list /input_folder/{{ $json.SAMPLE_ID }}/ --project-id {{ $json.PROJECT_ID }} --data-type FILE --parent-folder -o json | jq -r '.items[]? | select(.details.name != null) | .details.name'

=FILE=$(find /volume1/illuminastorage/fastq_folder/{{ $json.FOLDER }}/ -type f -name '*{{ $json.SAMPLE_ID }}*_R1*.fastq.gz' 2>/dev/null | head -1); if [ -z "$FILE" ]; then echo 'false'; exit 0; fi; HDR=$(zcat "$FILE" 2>/dev/null | head -1); echo "$HDR" | grep -qE ':[ACGTN]{6,}\+[ACGTN]{6,}$' && echo 'true' || echo 'false'

parameters.query:
SELECT dop.uniqueref AS dop_id,
       rd.sample_id,
       r.account_id AS project_id,
       rd.r1_path,
       rd.r2_path,
       CASE WHEN r.pipeline_name ILIKE '%ctDNA%' THEN 'ctDNA_v2' ELSE 'HT' END AS panel
FROM data_operations dop
JOIN data_operation_recipes r ON r.uniqueref = dop.recipe_ref
JOIN reads rd ON rd.uniqueref = dop.read_ref
WHERE r.platform_concept_ref = 547
  AND dop.status_concept_ref = 24
  AND rd.r1_path IS NOT NULL;

parameters.command: =S="{{ $json.sample_id }}"; P="{{ $json.project_id }}"; R1="{{ $json.r1_path }}"; ICA=/volume1/ALLDATA/bios/illumina/icav2; REMOTE=$("$ICA" projectdata list "/input_folder/$S/" --project-id "$P" --data-type FILE --parent-folder -o json 2>/dev/null | jq -r '[.items[]? | select(.details.name != null)] | length'); [ -z "$REMOTE" ] && REMOTE=0; HDR=$(zcat "$R1" 2>/dev/null | head -1); UMI=false; echo "$HDR" | grep -qE ':[ACGTN]{6,}\+[ACGTN]{6,}$' && UMI=true; printf '%s|%s\n' "$REMOTE" "$UMI"

parameters.query: =UPDATE data_operations SET status_concept_ref = 26, updated_at = now() WHERE uniqueref = {{ $json.dop_id }} AND status_concept_ref = 24 RETURNING uniqueref;
